title: ElevenLabs, TwelveLabs, ThirteenLabs
summary: The article humorously compares AI labs (ElevenLabs, TwelveLabs, ThirteenLabs) as a satirical take on the proliferation of AI companies, likely discussing their naming, hype, and overlapping capabilities. It critiques the trend of AI startups with similar-sounding names and questionable differentiation, using wit to highlight industry absurdities.
